digest.component_or_area: development process audit evaluation and decision reconciliation
propositions: Six process improvement proposals from the 2026-08-15 frozen audit (detected_by metadata, deterministic preflight, completion classification, risk tiers, debt management, maintainership breadth) must be evaluated against prior audit decisions, janitor outcomes, and implementation tickets before work prioritization.

Escaped-defect metadata via detected_by field was implemented as optional zero-friction capture (7 of 648 bugs tagged) and should be refined by expanding automation boundaries and measurement, not by adding mandatory fields or global backfill.

Deterministic plan preflight currently enforces P1-P11 mechanical conditions; extension should derive from persisted failure cohorts with offline replay, false-positive ceilings, and fail-open behavior, not from new generic frameworks or riskiest-assumption blockers.

Completion-failure classification should first derive historical failure sidecars into code defect, unmet AC, missing evidence, scope gap, environment/integration, and verifier-failure categories before adding durable reason codes to avoid conflating implementation defects with other non-PASS causes.

Risk-tiered review signals (security/store/concurrency surfaces, diff breadth, module complexity, plan failures) should be piloted via reporting without merge enforcement; blocking thresholds require prospective validation of defect/revert rates and override precision rather than human-review mandates.

Autonomous governance for this Gerrit project requires durably distinguishing author from reviewer models and monitoring provider diversity and recovery paths, not mandatory human approval or reviewer rotation which contradict the clarified autonomous contribution process.
